verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party Exa documentation on robots.txt compliance, content licensing, or terms governing permitted use of search results. One HN submission alleges Exa ignores robots.txt, but that is a third-party claim, not a documented stance, so it cannot credit this story. The axis clearly applies to a web search and crawling API, so this is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can read a documented stance on robots.txt, content licensing, and permitted use of results
